API Kit

Run the Server¶

Start the development server from your project folder:

$ <font color="#4E9A06">kit serve</font> --reload

  <span style="background-color:#009485"><font color="#D3D7CF"> KIT </font></span>  Serving on http://127.0.0.1:9000
  <FONT COLOR="#A40000">Press CTRL+C to stop</FONT>

The page template marks the greeting with a span; this is source code, so its tags stay:

<p>Hello, <span class="name">Ada</span>!</p>
